ETV throttle-demand clamp, HIGH bound. FUN_0008AE3E: _DAT_fef02d98 = clamp((torque_demand-0x8000)*RPM_gain/8 + 0x8000, hi=0x192CEA, lo=0x192CEC). RPM_gain from map 0x174710/0x174724 (pos/neg error).

ETV throttle-demand clamp, LOW bound (pair of 0x192CEA). See FUN_0008AE3E.

0x166E8C: Fuel :: Injector size scaler K (global pulse multiplier)

Global injector size/quantity scaler. FUN_0004E5FA sets final injector time = deadtime + base_time*(K-400)/200 (K = this value) then saturates to 0..65535. Effective multiplier = (K-400)/200 (e.g. 600 = x1.00, 620 = x1.10, 400 = x0). Raise to richen ALL cylinders (primary and secondary) proportionally, lower to lean.
0x1670EE: Fuel :: Primary injector flow trim - Cyl 1

Per-cylinder PRIMARY injector flow trim (cylinder 1). FUN_0004D68C selects this byte by cylinder index and scales the primary pulse: primary_time = air_charge * split * trim / 8388608. Proportional - lower = less primary fuel on this cylinder, higher = more. Stock is equal across cylinders.

Per-cylinder PRIMARY injector flow trim (cylinder 2). FUN_0004D68C selects this byte by cylinder index and scales the primary pulse: primary_time = air_charge * split * trim / 8388608. Lower = less primary fuel on this cylinder, higher = more.

0x1670F2: Secondary (showerhead) injector flow scaler. FUN_0004D68C applies it ONLY to the secondary-injector outputs: secondary_time = air_charge * this / 16384 (and on the per-cyl path air_charge * trim * this). Scales all secondary-injector pulse time - lower = less secondary fuel, higher = more. Role (scales secondary injector time) is code-proven; the exact label 'flow scaler' is a strong inference - verify.
0x166FC4: Lower clamp on the computed base injection time, applied by FUN_0004D68C via FUN_000A1C86 (lo bound) BEFORE deadtime is added. Native base-time units. The base pulse cannot fall below this.
0x166FC6: Upper clamp on the computed base injection time, applied by FUN_0004D68C via FUN_000A1C86 (hi bound) BEFORE deadtime is added. Native base-time units (stock ~25000, about 25 ms if microseconds). Raise only if your max-RPM injection window allows the longer pulse.

EXCV H-bridge drive voltage-compensation, bank A. FUN_0004C8D0 looks this up by commanded duty (0-255) x battery voltage (0xFEBF63C4) to scale PWM so valve speed is constant across Vbatt; feeds fef00dd2/dd3, final H-bridge PWM at 0xFEBF603D/603E. Previously mislabeled 'Fuel :: Primary Trim'; stock cells near-neutral (0x80).

EXCV H-bridge drive voltage-compensation, bank B (other H-bridge side). Same axes/role as map A. Previously mislabeled 'Fuel :: Secondary Trim'; stock cells near-neutral (0x80).
